Backgrounds: Allies 2, Artifact 1, Influence 2. Occult specialties: Art of Spirit Summoning +3, Art of Weather Control +3. Spirit Summoning: tribal small gods and ancestors only. Weather Control: (Charisma + Occult), diff 2 minimum, costs 2 motes/level of effect.
system.biography: Often tribe leaders or advisors living as hermits, communing with spirits, suffering visions and possessions. They communicate in ecstatic dances, ominous poetry and mad babble, bartering with spirit courts and summoning the dead.
